title: Beetle Astronaut on Occult Moon
description: A pixelated yellow beetle-headed astronaut in a green spacesuit stands triumphantly on a cratered black moon surface. The figure holds a tall staff topped with a scarab beetle in one hand and a small patterned orb in the other, surrounded by lit candles, pentagrams, and scattered gold coins.
prompt: A menacing yellow pixelated beetle with large eyes and a long golden beard, wearing a detailed green astronaut spacesuit and helmet, stands on a dark cratered moon. The beetle astronaut holds a tall staff with a scarab beetle on top in one hand and a small orange patterned sphere in the other. The moon surface is covered with lit black candles, inverted pentagrams, and scattered gold coins and rings. The background is black space with colorful bokeh orbs and motion streaks. Chalky white outlines, vibrant and surreal digital painting style.
